name: comp-394

frames.best_why: The avatar and green online dot are shown clear and centred with the name beneath.

tagline: A round profile photo carries a tiny green dot for being online.
summary: A circular avatar with a small green status dot overlapping its lower-right edge. It marks a person as online; the name and Online caption beneath come from the demo.
appearance: Centred on a near-black page is a small round portrait with a bright green dot ringed in dark at its lower-right corner. Below it sit a bold white name and a grey 'Online' label.
behaviour: Static: nothing moves or responds. The green dot simply shows an online state.
demo_content: Portrait of Kelly King with the name 'Kelly King' and the caption 'Online'.
search_phrases: profile picture with green online dot
show if a user is online
small green dot on profile photo
use_when: A person's photo should show at a glance whether they are available right now.
avoid_when: The dot is colour only and very small, so it is easy to miss and hard to read for colour-blind users.
customise: The photo URL, alt text, KK fallback and the green dot colour are fixed in the file; a different status needs a source edit.
weight_why: One image and one small dot; nothing animates.

a11y.note: The photo has alt text and the dot hides an 'Online' label for screen readers; colour alone carries the visual status.

issues: Online status relies on a tiny green dot, which colour-blind or low-vision users may miss.
polish_why: Clean, simple avatar badge; a standard control with little beyond the dot.
